name: usage-summary
title: Usage Summary
description: What a run used and what it cost, by unit, never added across units: a button of its totals (UsageAmount: the app's formatted value, its unit, its completeness), each saying how far it is to be trusted in words, not a colour (≈ and Estimated, Partial, Not reconciled, No price; not known is "Unknown", never 0); "So far" while it runs; opened, its breakdown (UsageSummaryRows: a row's label, amount and completeness, a button to its source and why, a popover, by touch too) and what has no price (missing). UsageSummaryRows alone goes in an AgentTurnInfo's details. The app adds the amounts, by unit; it fetches nothing.
